title: AQIS lab pack manifest, version 1.0
description: A test pack: its clips and the archives holding them. Contract document: docs/contracts/PACK_MANIFEST.md. The validator also checks that clip_id and archive names are unique and that every clip's archive is listed. Patterns end in $(?!\n) so that they mean 'end of text' in both ECMA-262 and Python.

manifest_id.description: Stable pack name, such as smoke.

created_utc.description: When the manifest was written, UTC ISO 8601 with Z.

clips.description: The clips of the pack; clip_id unique.

archives.description: The archives holding the clips; name unique.

file_name.description: One path segment: not '.' or '..', no '/', backslash or control character.

relative_path.description: Relative POSIX path: no leading '/', no '.', '..' or empty segment, no backslash or control character.

clip_id.description: Clip identifier, unique across the registry.

source.description: Where the clip comes from; owner and campaign mark owner and campaign recordings.

source_ref.description: Reference inside the source, such as the original file.

speaker_id.description: Speaker identifier, or null for non-speech clips.

consent_ref.description: Consent reference; required (not null) for owner and campaign recordings.

split.description: Split or category of the clip.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the clip file's bytes.

archive.description: Name of the archive holding the clip; listed in archives.

member_path.description: Path of the clip inside its archive.

recipe.description: How a derived clip was made, or null; members not fixed in v1.0.

consent_ref.description: Rule: owner and campaign recordings need a consent reference.

name.description: Archive file name; unique in the manifest.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive file's bytes.

n_members.description: Number of members in the archive.
